description: This file implements the backend for persistent storage of reporting and NEL (Network Error Logging) policies and endpoints using SQLite. It manages database schema creation, migration, and batch processing of database operations, including loading, adding, updating, and deleting policies and endpoints. It also records metrics related to loaded policies and endpoints.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentReportingAndNelStore::Backend
classes.description: Backend class managing SQLite database operations for reporting and NEL policies/endpoints, including schema creation, migration, batching, and loading.

classes.name: PendingOperation
classes.description: Template class representing a pending database operation (add, update, delete) for a specific data type.

classes.name: NelPolicyInfo
classes.description: Struct holding serialized information about a NEL policy for database storage.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointInfo
classes.description: Struct holding serialized information about a reporting endpoint for database storage.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointGroupInfo
classes.description: Struct holding serialized information about a reporting endpoint group for database storage.
